content.title: About
content.content: Chicken or turkey divan is a baked casserole made with finely chopped poultry, a creamy sauce, cheese, and often rice or pasta. The dish has a tender flavor, silky texture, and is typically layered to resemble a “divan.”

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name “divan” comes from the French word for a layered dish.
The original recipe often used chicken liver, but modern versions substitute lean meat.
The dish became popular in the United States in the 1950s as a convenient way to use leftover boiled meat.
A golden crust is usually achieved with a mixture of breadcrumbs and grated Parmesan.
Turkey versions are considered more diet‑friendly because turkey is lower in fat than chicken.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken and turkey provide complete protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: The dish supplies niacin, vitamin B6 and B12, which support energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Source of minerals
items.content: Poultry contributes iron, zinc, and phosphorus, important for blood formation and bone health.

items.title: Low in carbs
items.content: When rice or pasta is used in moderation, the dish fits moderate‑carbohydrate diets.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: The grated cheese topping adds calcium, beneficial for bone strength.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Cream sauce and cheese can trigger reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Prepared sauces often contain a lot of salt; low‑sodium alternatives are recommended.

items.title: Risk of over‑consumption
items.content: The dish can be calorie‑dense due to cream and cheese, so portion control is advised.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Poultry must be cooked thoroughly to prevent salmonella.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Sauté finely chopped chicken or turkey until golden, add a creamy sauce (butter, flour, milk), stir in cooked rice or pasta, place in a baking dish, top with grated cheese and bake 20‑30 minutes at 180 °C until a golden crust forms.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Cool the finished divan to room temperature, then store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze up to 2 months; thaw in the fridge before reheating.
